Em caso de desistência, por favor entrar em contato com a organização.

Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IFMGBetimAoCubo2026/register). [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com)

A inscrição só será confirmada no site da WCA após confirmação do pagamento.

Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a equipe de organização, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais.

###### Español 
Coralito Bahia de Banderas esta de vuelta!

Coralito Bahía de Banderas regresa para celebrar su **segunda edición**, retomando el lugar donde comenzó todo. Hace dos años, este evento marcó un momento especial al convertirse en la **primera competencia de la WCA realizada en Bahía de Banderas**, reuniendo por primera vez a speedcubers y aficionados en una misma sede.

Esta segunda edición busca volver a reunir a la comunidad del cubing para compartir la emoción de competir, mejorar tiempos, conocer nuevos competidores y, sobre todo, disfrutar de la pasión por los cubos Rubik.

Esta competencia es organizada por la comunidad **Vallarta Speed**.

Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia.

##### AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA
En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades.
Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad.
📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

###### English
Coralito Bahía de Banderas is back!

Coralito Bahía de Banderas returns for its **second edition**, going back to the place where it all began. Two years ago, this event marked a special moment by becoming the **first WCA competition ever held in Bahía de Banderas**, bringing speedcubers and enthusiasts together at the same venue for the first time.

This second edition aims to bring the cubing community together once again to share the excitement of competing, improving times, meeting new competitors, and, above all, enjoying the passion for Rubik’s Cubes.

This competition is organized by the **Vallarta Speed community**.


This competition is recognized as a World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.

##### NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY
Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities.
By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice.
📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

**PRE-CHAMPIONSHIP ATHENS 2026**

Στις 14 και 15 Νοεμβρίου 2026, όλοι οι Cubers συναντιόμαστε ξανά στο **Panellinios Club House** για έναν ξεχωριστό διήμερο διαγωνισμό γεμάτο ταχύτητα, συναγωνισμό και όμορφες στιγμές.

Το **PRE-CHAMPIONSHIP ATHENS 2026** θα αποτελέσει ταυτόχρονα την 3η αγωνιστική της **GREEK CUBING LEAGUE**!
Τα μέλη της **GREEK CUBING LEAGUE** ([https://greekcubingleague.gr](https://greekcubingleague.gr)) θα έχουν **επιστροφή 4€** στην κάρτα τους, αμέσως μόλις οριστικοποιηθεί η εγγραφή τους μετά την ημερομηνία που αυτές θα κλείσουν.

Ο διαγωνισμός αυτός, που θα διαρκέσει και τις δυο μέρες του Σαββατοκύριακου, αποτελεί το ιδανικό αγωνιστικό warm-up πριν από το μεγάλο γεγονός της χρονιάς, το **Εθνικό μας Πρωτάθλημα**. 
Είναι η ευκαιρία να δοκιμάσετε τις δυνάμεις σας, να βελτιώσετε τις επιδόσεις σας και να προετοιμαστείτε κατάλληλα για τη μεγάλη διοργάνωση που ακολουθεί.

Ετοιμαστείτε για ακόμη ένα αξέχαστο cubing Σαββατοκύριακο! 
Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε να ζήσουμε μαζί μια ακόμη μεγάλη γιορτή του cubing!

Παρακαλούμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες.

**Σημείωση:** Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή, πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στη σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **ΚΑΙ** να γίνει η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών Stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα.
Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. 

Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. 

[Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg)

[Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI)

**PRE-CHAMPIONSHIP ATHENS 2026**

On November 14 and 15, 2026, all Cubers will meet again at **Panellinios Club House** for a special two-day competition filled with speed, competition and unforgettable moments.

The **PRE-CHAMPIONSHIP ATHENS 2026** will also be the third competition of the **GREEK CUBING LEAGUE**!

Members of the **GREEK CUBING LEAGUE** ([https://greekcubingleague.gr](https://greekcubingleague.gr)) will receive a **€4 refund** on their card as soon as their registration is finalized, upon completion of the registration process.

Taking place over both days of the weekend, this competition will be the ideal competitive warm-up before the biggest event of the year: **our National Championship**. It is the perfect opportunity to test your skills, improve your performances and prepare properly for the major competition that follows.

Get ready for another unforgettable cubing weekend! Bring your cubes, read the regulations and join us for another great celebration of cubing!

# Selamat Datang di Rapid Academy Indonesian Championship 2026!

Rapid Academy Indonesian Championship 2026 merupakan kejuaraan nasional speedcubing yang akan diadakan di Lippo Icon Gajah Mada, Jakarta. Kompetisi ini akan diadakan selama tiga hari dan terbuka untuk umum.

Setiap peserta diharapkan untuk memerhatikan time limit dan cut-off untuk setiap event karena diatur lebih ketat daripada kompetisi biasanya.

Setiap peserta wajib hadir 15 menit sebelum event yang diikuti dimulai. Jika peserta terlambat, maka panitia berhak mendiskualifikasi peserta tersebut.

**Pendaftaran on the spot TIDAK AKAN DITERIMA.**

**Catatan Penting:**
Terdapat batasan limit peserta untuk Event berikut:
* 3x3x3 Fewest Moves (terbatas untuk 24 pendaftar pertama)
* 4x4x4 Blindfolded (terbatas untuk 10 pendaftar pertama)
* 5x5x5 Blindfolded (terbatas untuk 10 pendaftar pertama)
* 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (terbatas untuk 20 pendaftar pertama)

Akan ada **3 jenis pemenang** dalam kompetisi ini:
* **Kategori Indonesia** - 3 pemenang teratas yang mewakili Indonesia di setiap kategori
* **Kategori Terbuka** - 3 pemenang teratas kompetisi tanpa memandang kewarganegaraan
* **Kategori Anak (Indonesia)** - Top 3 pemenang kompetisi untuk peserta berkewarganegaraan Indonesia berusia di bawah 13 tahun (per 01 November 2026) untuk event 3x3x3

Dengan mendaftar, peserta dan pendamping setuju bahwa penyelenggara, NSA, dan WCA tidak bertanggung jawab atas cedera pribadi atau kerusakan/kehilangan barang selama acara berlangsung.

Peserta akan mendapatkan Lanyard dan Name Tag.

Pastikan memantau jadwal selama periode pendaftaran terbuka jadwal dapat berubah tergantung jumlah pendaftar tiap event.

Silakan melakukan registrasi di laman [daftar](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IndonesianChampionship2026/register) dan konfirmasi di form ini: https://forms.gle/Yq4km6UVR2qt2Jnw7.
Jika Anda tidak dapat mengakses form tersebut, silakan mengirimkan bukti pembayaran registrasi ke email ini: [nlarchie1@gmail.com](mailto:nlarchie1@gmail.com). Dalam email tersebut, mohon tuliskan nama lengkap, WCA ID (jika Anda memilikinya), tanggal lahir, daftar event yang diikuti, dan bukti pembayaran.

-----------------------

# Welcome to Rapid Academy Indonesian Championship 2026!

Rapid Academy Indonesian Championship 2026 is the national speedcubing championship that will be held at Lippo Icon Gajah Mada, Jakarta. The competition will take place over three days and is open to the public.

All competitors are expected to pay close attention to the time limit and cut-off for each event, as they are set more strictly than in a typical competition.

All competitors must arrive 15 minutes before the event starts. If the competitor is late, the competitor will be disqualified.

**On the Spot registration WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED.**

**Important Notes:**
There are competitor limits for the following events:
* 3x3x3 Fewest Moves (limited to the first 24 registered competitors)
* 4x4x4 Blindfolded (limited to the first 10 registered competitors)
* 5x5x5 Blindfolded (limited to the first 10 registered competitors)
* 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (limited to the first 20 registered competitors)

There will be **3 categories of winners** in this competition:
* **Indonesian Category** - The top 3 Indonesian competitors in each event
* **Open Category** - The top 3 competitors overall, regardless of nationality
* **Kids Category (Indonesia)** - Top 3 winners of the competition among Indonesian citizens under 13 years of age (as of 01 November 2026) in the 3x3x3 event

By registering, competitors and their guests acknowledge that the organizers, the NSA, and the WCA are not responsible for any personal injury or any loss of or damage to personal belongings during the event.

All competitors will receive a Lanyard and a Name Tag.

Please check the competition schedule regularly during the registration period, as it may change depending on the number of registrations for each event.

Please register on the [register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IndonesianChampionship2026/register) page and confirm your registration by completing this form: https://forms.gle/Yq4km6UVR2qt2Jnw7.
If you cannot access the form, please submit your proof of payment for the registration to this email: [nlarchie1@gmail.com](mailto:nlarchie1@gmail.com). In the email, please write your full name, WCA ID (if you have it), date of birth, list of events, and the proof of payment.

items.information:
A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz.

**ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades.
**ATENÇÃO:** Devido ao tamanho do local da competição, apenas um acompanhante será permitido por competidor. Façamos a competição ser possível para todos os competidores!
Esta competição funcionará da seguinte maneira:
Os competidores poderão fazer quantas modalidades queiram, contanto que se atentem ao limite cumulativo de **30 minutos** para todas as suas tentativas.
Cada competidor será alocado em um grupo (1, 2 ou 3), no qual irá competir. Nos demais grupos, o competidor deverá, obrigatoriamente, atuar como juiz, embaralhador ou corredor, sob a condição de ter seus resultados desqualificados caso se recuse.
Apenas o primeiro colocado de cada modalidade será premiado.

---

Registration is open to any person, from any country.

With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge.

**ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of its events.
**ATTENTION:** Due to the size of the competition's venue, only one guest will be allowed per competitor. Please do not bring more guests than the allowed quantity, let's make the competition possible for all competitors!
This competition will work as follows:
Competitors may attempt as many events as they wish, as long as they adhere to the cumulative time limit of **30 minutes** for all their attempts.
Each competitor will be assigned to a group (1, 2, or 3) in which they will compete. In the other groups, the competitor must serve as a judge, scrambler, or runner; refusal to do so may result in disqualification of their results.
Only the first-place finisher in each event will receive a prize.

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjE4NjQxLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ab88a0502a3ba472356141b81e552f91ce257a19/image.png)

### Deutsch

Herzlich willkommen zu Cottbus Cubing 2026!

Wir freuen uns sehr, euch alle zur zweiten offiziellen Speedcubing-Competition in der Lausitz begrüßen zu dürfen! Am Wochenende vom 06. bis 08. November wollen wir an den Erfolg des Vorjahres anknüpfen und Euch alle wieder herzlichst nach Cottbus einladen. Dieses Jahr möchten wir uns sogar noch steigern und gehen mit mehr Teilnehmenden und mehr Comp-Tagen an den Start. Dieses Jahr wird Cottbus Cubing von GANCube unterstützt

Wir wünschen allen Teilnehmenden spannende Wettkämpfe, faire Duelle und vor allem viel Freude am Würfeln!

**Bitte lies dir alle Tabs sorgfältig durch, damit du mit dem Ablaufplan und allen Modalitäten vertraut bist.**

### English

Welcome to the Cottbuser Cubing Competition!

We are delighted to welcome you all to the second official Speedcubing Competition in the Lausitz! From November 6th to 8th, we aim to build on last year's success and happily want to invite you all to Cottbus once again. This year, we want to surpass even that, with more participants and more competition days. This year, Cottbus Cubing is being supported by GANCube

We wish all participants exciting solves, fair competition, and – above all – lots of fun with the cubes!

**Please make sure to read all information on the competition page carefully before registering.**

Vielen Dank!
Habt alle ein entspanntes Wochenende

Welcome to Götalandsmästerskapet 2026!

Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes.

We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

Anyone who wants is warmly welcome to participate, regardless of previous experience or where in the world you live. Note, however, that only competitors who live in Götaland can win titles and prizes at the Götaland Championship, read more about this under the tab "[Regional Championships](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Gotalandsmasterskapet2026#77782-regionala-masterskap-2026-regional-championships-2026)".

items.information:
First official WCA competition in Namibia.

Everyone can participate, but only people with Namibia nationality can win prizes and honours.

Three spots in the 3x3 final will be reserved for participants with Namibia nationality.

The competition is part of a tour around six countries in three weeks. That is why this competition will take place on a Wednesday afternoon and evening.
